about: The North Devon Surf School has run lessons in Westward Ho! since 1988. Its purpose-built surf and hire centre is about 50 metres from the beach, with public parking next door. It hires out wetsuits, surfboards and bodyboards alongside group and private lessons.
where: 1 Pebbleridge Rd, Westward Ho!, Bideford EX39 1HN, about 50 m from the beach
goodToKnow: Changing rooms, storage and a warm shower on site
Public parking next to the centre
gaps: No hire terms, opening hours or season stated.
